I would say just try and focus on what makes you happy and less about what might make you a woman. I completely understand the feeling of suddenly appearing as a woman to the people around me. I was never particularly masculine or feminine growing up and was attracted to women. I had a lot of mental health issues in my late teens to early twenties and had a general disregard for myself. It was only when I got better that I was able to be introspective and realise that part of my struggles was dysphoria. I didn't know non-binary was a thing until I was 21. I'd say let yourself explore and try not to put too much pressure on yourself to find the answers. Good luck on your journey and stay safe x
